infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Duna uses the camera to record and live stream beach volleyball.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Duna uses the microphone only when you choose to include audio in a recording or live stream.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Duna lets you choose volleyball videos to add to your private archive or profile.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Duna reads the Apple Health categories you choose to build your private performance timeline, compare recovery with matches, and align heart rate with your Duna Vision recordings.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Duna does not write to or change your Apple Health data. This read-only version includes HealthKit access only so you can choose which Health data Duna may use for your private performance timeline and video overlays.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Duna uses contacts you select to find frequent partners or send a one-time game invitation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Duna uses your location to show nearby play and venues.
